attachments.name: medical_plan.txt
attachments.text:
EVENT MEDICAL PLAN
Beacon Spring Dash 10K, Sunday 2 May 2027
Applicant: Beacon Food Bank
Issue: 3.3

Some background. Our committee has run this race for a number of years and takes the welfare of runners to heart. One of our longtime members is a retired paramedic who usually runs the race herself and is not on duty that day.

1. Event summary
A 10K race with 150 runners, starting at 08:00 in the Clocktower Square area of Port Halden. An ambulance from Sentinel Ambulance Service is on site for the race; the paperwork is attached.

2. First aid cover
3 first aid posts will operate, at the start, at the finish and at the course midpoint, staffed by 8 qualified first aiders. Posts are placed so that no part of the course is more than 1.5 km from one. Two cycle responders move along the course with defibrillators.

3. Weather and hydration
Water is available every 2.5 km. The race director checks the forecast 48 hours and 2 hours before the start. Above 28 degrees C the start is brought forward or the course shortened, and above 32 degrees C the race is cancelled. In cold or wet conditions, foil blankets and a warm shelter are at the finish.

4. Transfer to hospital
Should anyone require hospital treatment, the emergency services would be called in the normal way and would make the necessary arrangements for transfer, in line with their usual procedures.

5. Communications
Every first aid post and cycle responder carries a radio on the medical channel, with phones as backup. All calls for an ambulance go through the medical lead, who gives the crew the access point and the nearest barrier to open.

6. Clinical lead
Responsibility for welfare on the day rests with the race director, supported by the wider committee, all of whom take the wellbeing of participants extremely seriously.

attachments.name: traffic_plan.txt
attachments.text:
TRAFFIC MANAGEMENT PLAN
Event: Beacon Spring Dash 10K
Date: Sunday 2 May 2027
Applicant: Beacon Food Bank
Prepared by: Brightway Traffic Consulting
Issue: 3.3

1. Scope
This plan describes how traffic will be managed for the Beacon Spring Dash 10K, a 10K race in the Clocktower Square area of Port Halden with a 08:00 start. It has been prepared to accompany the permit application and should be read with the race plan. We have not arranged any police attendance for this race.

2. Road closures
Temporary closures will be in force as follows, with barriers and advance signing supplied by Northline Barriers.
- Foundry Street, Fenwick Street to Mill Road: closed 06:30 to 10:30
- Eastern Link Road, Salter Way to Vine Street: closed 06:30 to 10:30
- Spring Way, Vine Street to Fenwick Street: closed 06:30 to 10:30
- Bell Street, Mill Road to Vine Street: closed 06:30 to 10:30
- Copper Row, Quay Street to Mill Road: closed 06:30 to 10:30

3. Major crossings
Busier junctions along the course will receive appropriate supervision during the event. Staffing levels will be determined by Northline Barriers on the morning, taking account of conditions at the time, with resources deployed flexibly to where they are most needed.

4. Diversions
Signed diversions will operate for the duration of the closures.
- Foundry Street: traffic diverted via High Street and Ferry Road, signed from Abbey Road
- Eastern Link Road: traffic diverted via Ferry Road and High Street, signed from Fenwick Street
- Spring Way: traffic diverted via Cross Avenue and Station Road, signed from Fenwick Street
- Bell Street: traffic diverted via Queen's Road and High Street, signed from Abbey Road
- Copper Row: traffic diverted via Cross Avenue and Ferry Road, signed from Fenwick Street

5. Emergency vehicle access
The emergency services will be made aware of the event date and general location through the usual channels ahead of the day. Any vehicle attending an incident will be accommodated by staff on the ground as circumstances allow.

6. Notification
All frontages on the closed streets receive a letter drop 21 days before the event, with a further reminder at 7 days. Advance notice signs go up 10 days before, and bus operators have been given the closure times.

7. Reopening
Roads will be reopened following the conclusion of the event, once barriers and equipment have been removed by the contractor.
